subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should OpenClaw add a Control UI channel-view mode as a focused Sessions page feature, fold it into the broader sessions workspace design, or defer it to keep the current cross-channel context model?
rationale: The code already exposes channel metadata, but the requested merged timeline and separated tabs require maintainer intent on UX, privacy, routing, and whether new Gateway/query or persisted preference surfaces are acceptable.

options.title: Keep focused channel-view issue
options.body: Define a Control UI-only separated/merged channel view on top of existing session rows, adding protocol support only if source inspection proves the UI cannot derive the chosen view safely.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 the canonical design and handle channel views as one facet of a broader Web/TUI sessions workspace.

options.title: Defer channel modes
options.body: Keep current cross-channel context and session list behavior, documenting that channel-specific monitoring is not planned until stronger user demand or a security/privacy gap appears.

recommendation.title: Keep focused channel-view issue
recommendation.body: Define a Control UI-only separated/merged channel view on top of existing session rows, adding protocol support only if source inspection proves the UI cannot derive the chosen view safely.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal for Control UI session behavior and product/API routing is Peter Steinberger's recent and earlier sessions/dashboard work.
